# GeoHydroAI Knowledge API

> Evidence-grounded access to a corpus of ~4.8k flood, hydrology and remote-sensing papers. It covers full-text passages, semantic search, a citation and entity graph, metric facts, DOI and bibliography verification, quote and claim checks, thesis evidence, discovery of new papers and legal open-access ingestion.
> Base URL `http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1`. Header `X-API-Key`. Errors are `application/problem+json`. Every answer carries `provenance` (`corpus_manifest_id`, collection, model).
> PostgreSQL is the layer of truth; Neo4j, Chroma and Parquet are projections.

Agents MUST read the rules first. The non-negotiable ones:
- quote, don't recall;
- every number comes with its source sentence;
- "not found" is not "does not exist", and gap or novelty claims need the gate (CANDIDATE_GAP);
- model verdicts are labelled model-assessed (there are no human labels yet);
- record provenance;
- acquire papers only from open-access sources.

## Rules and conventions
- [AGENT_RULES.md](AGENT_RULES.md): mandatory rules for AI agents, task → endpoint table, workflows, error handling, checklist
- [QUERY_GUIDE.md](QUERY_GUIDE.md): how to query the corpus and choose the data source: agent prompt (MCP prompt `research`), store limits, English sentence-like queries, compressed similarity scores, filters, recipes
- [README.md](README.md): base URL, auth and scopes, conventions, error codes, provenance and retrieval validity, jobs and quota
- [SCHEMAS.md](SCHEMAS.md): Provenance, Problem, Coverage, RetrievalValidity, PaperIdentity (implemented), EvidenceSpan, ChunkHit, Job, QuoteResult, DoiVerifyResult, Thesis, AtomicClaim, ClaimCheckResult, ScreeningLabel, Candidate, Acquisition, MetricFact, GraphBundle
- [MCP_TOOLS.md](MCP_TOOLS.md): MCP tools for Claude Code (`http://127.0.0.1:8090/mcp`, implemented: 31 read tools, docs as resources, workflows W1–W6 as prompts)
- [PAPER_WORKFLOW.md](PAPER_WORKFLOW.md): building a paper with the workbench: passport → theses → literature → citations → bibliography → tables/figures → assembly → review → delivery into the paper repository
- [PROJECT_MANIFEST.md](PROJECT_MANIFEST.md): `ghai.project.yaml`, how a paper repository describes its paper (paths, placeholder dialect, citation style, review rules)

## Endpoints
- [system](endpoints/system.md): GET /health, /capabilities, /stats, /manifest, /schemas/{name}, /client.py, /llms.txt; documentation served by the API: GET /v1/agent-rules (rules as JSON or ?format=markdown), /v1/docs/index, /v1/docs/pages/{name}, /v1/docs/endpoint?method=&path= (one endpoint with the full text of its rules); Swagger UI at /docs, OpenAPI at /v1/openapi.json (every operation carries x-agent-rules and x-status)
- [papers](endpoints/papers.md): GET /papers/resolve; POST /papers/resolve-batch; GET /papers/{id}, /sections, /text, /references, /entities, /tables
- [search](endpoints/search.md): POST /search/chunks, /search/papers, /search/similar, /search/hybrid
- [graph](endpoints/graph.md): GET /graph/papers/{id}, /graph/papers/{id}/citations, /graph/entities/{label}/{canonical_id}/papers, /graph/queries; POST /graph/queries/{name}, /graph/cypher (admin)
- [metrics](endpoints/metrics.md): GET /metrics/facts, /metrics/ontology, /ontology/entities; POST /metrics/extract, /ontology/normalize
- [bibliography](endpoints/bibliography.md): GET /doi/{doi}; POST /doi/verify, /bib/format, /bib/audit, /bib/render, /manuscripts/citations
- [evidence](endpoints/evidence.md): POST /quotes/verify, /claims/check, /theses/validate, /theses/extract, /theses/evidence, /theses/evidence-run, /theses/novelty; GET /theses/sets/{project_id}
- [generate](endpoints/generate.md): POST /generate/synthesis, /generate/related-work, /generate/rewrite-check
- [acquisition](endpoints/acquisition.md): GET /locate (corpus files and legal open-access copies of a DOI or URL), /files/{token} (signed link that opens a corpus PDF for a person); POST /discovery/search, /discovery/snowball, /discovery/screen, /acquire, /ingest, /ingest/upload, /pipelines/discover-and-ingest; GET/PATCH /discovery/candidates
- [jobs](endpoints/jobs.md): GET /jobs, /jobs/{id}, /jobs/{id}/events (SSE); DELETE /jobs/{id}; POST /jobs/{id}/retry
- [bundles](endpoints/bundles.md): POST /bundles/import
- [admin](endpoints/admin.md): POST /admin/manifest/freeze, /admin/rebuild/{graph|vectors|analytics}, /admin/integrity/check
